title: Jeweled Yeasty Korean Oranges Kalguksu
description: A yeasty, flaky, and delicious Korean dish featuring oranges, made in a Dutch oven, and low in sodium, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt, and mix well.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl and knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Roll out the dough into a large sheet, about 1/4 inch thick.
Cut the dough into kalguksu shapes, about 1 inch wide and 2 inches long.
In a large Dutch oven, heat sesame oil over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add sliced oranges to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to caramelize.
Add soy sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the kalguksu shapes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, until they are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
